description: Implement TypeScript types, Supabase client, auth store (Zustand), and canvas/project state stores. This provides the complete data layer for the canvas UI: types matching the DB schema, Supabase client configuration, auth state with role-based access, project store for template/project data, and canvas store for viewport/zoom/selection/mode state with autosave debounce.
steps: Create src/types/database.ts with TypeScript interfaces matching the perfecity schema tables the frontend uses: Template, TemplateZone, TemplateZoneSku, TemplateLighting, TemplateFurniture, TemplateTrim, Project, ProjectSnapshot, ProjectMeasurement, ProjectConfiguration, SkuMaster, CatalogueEntry, WallGeometry (STRAIGHT/L_CORNER). Include enums for CanvasMode (DESIGNER/CONSULTANT), ZoneWidthStrategy, ZoneHeightStrategy, ZonePositionStrategy, TemplateStatus, ProjectStatus, AdaptationStrategy.

Create src/types/canvas.ts with canvas-specific types: Point (x, y in mm), Dimensions (width, height in mm), BoundingBox, ViewportState (zoom, panX, panY), GridConfig (size: 100, snapEnabled), CanvasLayer enum (GRID, WALL_OUTLINE, ZONES, SKU_PLACEMENT, LIGHTING, FURNITURE, TRIMS, MEASUREMENTS, SELECTION, GRID_OVERLAY), LayerVisibility map, SelectionState (selectedZoneId, resizeHandle), SaveStatus ('saving'|'saved'|'unsaved'|'error'), ZoneResizeHandle type (8-point: nw, n, ne, e, se, s, sw, w).
Create src/lib/supabase.ts - Initialize Supabase client using VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY env vars. Export the client and typed helper functions for common queries.

Create src/lib/coordinates.ts - Utility functions for coordinate transforms: canvasToScreen(point, viewport), screenToCanvas(point, viewport), snapToGrid(point, gridSize), mmToPixels(mm, zoom), pixelsToMm(px, zoom). The key transform: canvas Y origin is bottom-left but Konva Y origin is top-left, so screenY = wallHeight - canvasY.

Create src/stores/authStore.ts - Zustand store: user (from Supabase auth), role (extracted from JWT app_metadata.role: ADMIN|DESIGNER|CONSULTANT), isAuthenticated, signIn(), signOut(), subscribeToAuthChanges(). Use supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange for reactive auth.

Create src/stores/projectStore.ts - Zustand store: currentTemplate (Template | null), currentProject (Project | null), currentSnapshot (ProjectSnapshot | null), zones (TemplateZone[]), zoneSku (Map<zoneId, SkuMaster>), lighting (TemplateLighting[]), furniture (TemplateFurniture[]), trims (TemplateTrim[]), measurements (ProjectMeasurement | null), wallGeometry (WallGeometry). Actions: loadTemplate(id), loadProject(id), updateZone(zone), addZone(zone), removeZone(id), assignSku(zoneId, skuId), updateMeasurements(). All actions call Supabase and update local state optimistically.

Create src/stores/canvasStore.ts - Zustand store: mode (DESIGNER|CONSULTANT), viewport (zoom, panX, panY with default zoom fit-to-viewport), gridConfig (size:100, snapEnabled:true), layerVisibility (all layers visible by default), selection (selectedZoneId, activeHandle), saveStatus ('saved'), version (for optimistic locking). Actions: setMode(), setZoom(level, clamp 0.25-4.0), pan(dx, dy), toggleLayer(layer), selectZone(id), clearSelection(), setResizeHandle(handle), setSaveStatus(). Include a debouncedSave action that sets status to 'saving', calls persist, then sets 'saved' or 'error'. Debounce 2000ms.

Create src/lib/autosave.ts - Debounce utility (2000ms) that wraps Supabase upsert calls. Manages save status transitions: unsaved -> saving -> saved/error. Uses version column for optimistic locking (include version in UPDATE WHERE clause, retry on conflict).
Create src/stores/index.ts - Re-export all stores for clean imports.

Write unit tests in src/stores/__tests__/canvasStore.test.ts testing: zoom clamping (min 0.25, max 4.0), snap to grid calculation, coordinate transforms (bottom-left to top-left conversion), layer visibility toggling.
Write unit tests in src/lib/__tests__/coordinates.test.ts testing: canvasToScreen with known values, screenToCanvas roundtrip, snapToGrid at boundaries.
Run npm run build and npm run typecheck to confirm everything compiles
Run npm run test to confirm tests pass
acceptance_criteria: All TypeScript types compile with strict mode (npm run typecheck passes)
Supabase client initializes correctly with env vars
canvasStore correctly clamps zoom between 0.25 and 4.0
coordinates.ts correctly transforms bottom-left origin to top-left origin
All unit tests pass (npm run test)
findings: All 37 tests pass. TypeScript strict mode compiles cleanly. Build succeeds. snapToGrid handles -0 edge case with explicit zero check. Supabase client uses 'let' inference rather than explicit SupabaseClient type annotation due to generic schema parameter mismatch in v2.x. Zustand v5 create() works without middleware. tsconfig.tsbuildinfo updated by tsc -b during build.
